task_abi: 192-byte descriptor decoded only with generated replay_control_layout_pkg offsets.
readiness: processing_ready requires source_ready, !dsp_busy and !profile_commit. Wrapper idle additionally requires dispatcher idle and no DSP tail.
profile: Commit freezes RX DC/gain, matrix and RX/target/Doppler IDs. No FD phase/version lookup or dependency; legacy FD fields ignored, active_fd_version/phase and table_version always0. Profile changes blocked during reader/DSP ownership. Nonzero fraction rejected by legality checker.
stream: RAW feeds two RXCAL lanes then Target; output count equals accepted RAW count. No FD instance or62-sample flush. RAW token retirement remains separate from processing drain. Internal RXCAL input uses the reader registered payload directly, qualified by unchanged raw_valid/processing_fault; public RAW data still mutes immediately. No added stage or GSC latency.
cancel: hard_fault, abort, loss of RF/binding/time/clock permission, nonzero real token status, and owner epoch change while reader or DSP active drive DSP hard_fault. This cancels a missing-last underflow and old tails even after RAW token retirement. Restart requires a fresh accepted profile.
phase: Task-owned Q48 step/initial/reference GSC/output offset is frozen at actual dispatch edge from the dispatched head, one edge before the registered task_started pulse. This primes3-stage phase generation for the earliest legal RAW sample after FD removal. External phase ports remain compatibility-only. A new dispatch supersedes the previous DSP done pulse; processing_fault always cancels. Earliest and adjacent-task13-case test verifies both boundaries.
latency: Registered RAW output to Target output:3 RF intervals=12 GSC ticks, measured against target_gsc. RXCAL accept edge n to Target output n+2. Physical TXCAL/FIR/RFDC/RF reference delays still require independent binding.
ownership: Only frozen_replay_reader produces bank return tokens. Queued rejections require external disposition and never fabricate lease returns. Calibration/profile lifetime must include DSP tail independently of RAW lease retirement.

coverage: actual16-bank RAM to RXCAL/Target exact samples, all32 nonzero fraction bits rejected before RAM, arbitrary retired FD settings ignored
